text: Which statement correctly describes fungal body organization?
choices: The mushroom is the whole organism, and the underground threads are a separate, unrelated growth
Hyphae grow uniformly along their entire length, inflating like balloons
The mycelium is the network of thread-like hyphae, which extend by growth at their tips
Fungi are built from motile single cells that swim freely through the soil
explanation: The fungal body is the mycelium, a branching network of tubular hyphae that grow exclusively at their tips (guided by the Spitzenkorper vesicle cluster); the mushroom is merely the reproductive fruiting body. Hyphae do not elongate along their whole length (choice 1) and are not motile swimming cells (choice 3).
